sections.title: Prospectus Summary
sections.excerpt: PROSPECTUS SUMMARY Overview We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery and development of innovative, small molecule therapeutics targeting age-related degenerative diseases and disorders of the central nervous system, or CNS, and retina. Currently available therapies for these diseases are limited, with few Alzheimer’s disease, or AD, treatments, two approved treatments for geographic atrophy, or GA, secondary to age-related macular degeneration, or AMD, and no approved treatments for dementia with Lewy bodies, or DLB. Our goal is to develop disease-modifying treatments for patients with these degenerative disorders by initially leveraging our expertise in the S2R which is expressed by multiple cell types, including neuronal synapses, and acts as a key regulator of cellular damage commonly associated with certain age-related degenerative diseases of the C
